newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall as new arrivals rise.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall as new arrivals rise.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices fell to 1,164/1,165 rupees per quintal from 1,170/1,171 rupees as new crops came into the market, dealers said.

"Overseas buying remained low while improved new crop arrivals triggered fresh bull liquidation at higher levels," one dealer said. Groundnut oil was steady at the reduced level of 347/349 rupees per 10 kg on renewed physical enquiries while arrivals were low at 60/80 tonnes. Rajkot spot was steady at 520/525 rupees per 15 kg. Imported palm oil fell from 289/290 rupees to 286/287 rupees per 10 kg on arrivals of about 3,000 tonnes at Bombay port, dealers said.
